title: NOTIFY-2 what the App says about itself
description: PUT /v1/presence {foreground, alerts} from a native client (a web credential is 403 by browser_gate; any other non-companion is 403 presence_native_only). `alerts` lists the kinds the App puts on screen by itself while it is in front. Odomo's quiet_when_native_connected holds a push back only for those kinds, only while this device is in front and holds a live /v1/events stream. Memory only: a daemon restart forgets it, and the App says it again on every connection. The reply echoes it, plus `quiets`: the kinds this device now holds back.
